offering_biDashboard.name: Executive BI Dashboard with AI
offering_biDashboard.tagline: All your KPIs in one dashboard, with AI-generated summaries
offering_biDashboard.description: Visualize sales, finance and operations in real time with automatic explanations and forecasting. Delivered as software or monthly SaaS.

basico.name: Basic
basico.description: For SMBs that want clear KPIs without hiring a BI manager
basico.idealPara: Teams up to 50 people with data in Sheets or Postgres
incluye: Up to 100,000 rows processed per month
CSV, Google Sheets and Postgres connectors
Up to 5 dashboards with pre-built widgets
Optional automated executive summaries
Email support Mon–Fri 8AM–5PM Colombia, 24h business response

profesional.name: Professional
profesional.description: BI with warehouse and forecasting for mid-market companies
profesional.idealPara: Companies with data in ERP, CRM and marketing tools
incluye: Up to 1M rows processed per month
Optional warehouse (BigQuery or Snowflake)
ERP (Siigo, SAP B1) and CRM (HubSpot) connectors
AI forecasting per business line
Slack/Teams alerts for KPI deviations
Team permissions and basic row-level security
Email + WhatsApp support, 4h business response

avanzado.name: Advanced
avanzado.description: Multi-source BI with near real-time dashboards
incluye: Up to 25M rows processed per month
Enterprise warehouse with near real-time CDC
Federated sources (ERP + CRM + marketing + ops)
Advanced forecasting and AI anomaly detection
Granular row-level security per user
Scheduled exports to Excel/PowerPoint
Team workspaces with private dashboards
Email + WhatsApp + Slack Connect support, 2h business response

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: Corporate BI with governance and multi-warehouse
enterprise.idealPara: Enterprises with compliance and multiple business units
incluye: 250M+ rows processed per month
Multi-warehouse federation (Snowflake + Databricks)
Corporate data lineage and governance
Architecture aligned with SOC 2/ISO 27001 (certification at customer expense)
Multi-tenant row-level security per business unit
SSO SAML/OIDC + SCIM provisioning
PM + tech lead assigned
Jira/Zendesk tickets with audit, 1h critical / 4h high / 24h medium
Monthly executive reports for your committee

offering_biDashboard.costoNote: Warehouse costs (BigQuery/Snowflake ~$50–$20,000 USD/mo) and LLM costs are paid by the customer directly to the provider.
